what: The title sits hidden one line down (translateY 100%), stretched 1.5x vertically inside a frame closed at the bottom (clip inset bottom 100%), when it reaches 85% of the screen the frame opens and the title shrinks with the bottom as its axis and settles into place (.5s, cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,1), once). The ”x” type is pushed out from up to 50px to the left, stretched 1.5x horizontally inside a frame closed on the right — for vertical-writing titles and picture lettering

options.ease: Curve — a value like ”0.25,0.46,0.45,1” or a CSS curve name, default is the original curve
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top 85% (original top bottom-=15%)
options.look: x: Type that enters from the side (vertical title)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Moving text (child, required) — the frame is the element itself

from.where: shared.css · all page titles [data-fx=stretch-clip-rise] — original common.js scrollAnimFunc (.anim_y·.anim_x with top bottom-=At 15% adds .on) + style.css .anim_y{clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0)} .txt{translateY(100%) scaleY(1.5) origin bottom} · .anim_x{inset(0 100% 0 0)} .txt{translateX(clamp(-50px,-100%,0)) scaleX(1.5) origin right} · transition all .5s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,1)
